input:
We’re under pressure to deliver full compliance for our Welsh‑speaking policyholders, which includes letters in Welsh — without them, our renewal won’t proceed.
The platform does not support generating compliance letters in Welsh, preventing renewal for Welsh‑speaking policyholders.

Also, the last update moved the ‘reserves’ button — we had to retrain half the team because of that.
The recent update moved the ‘reserves’ button, causing confusion and requiring the team to be retrained.

Appreciate that — it’s been holding up payments and suppliers are starting to ask questions.
Payments are being held up, causing suppliers to inquire.

When a policyholder reports the same incident both by phone and through the web portal, the system doesn’t alert us — it just creates two separate claims, which is a classic duplicate loss report scenario and causes confusion in reserves and reporting.
The system creates duplicate claim entries when the same incident is reported through multiple channels because it fails to alert or link them.

Hi Bryn, I’m trying to reconcile the latest payment batch with our suppliers’ invoices but can’t locate the matching documents in the system.
The user cannot find the matching supplier invoice documents needed to reconcile a payment batch.

We need to assign clear roles and automate document routing — our current system doesn’t let us track tasks properly.
The current system does not allow clear role assignment, automated document routing, or proper task tracking.

can we automate letters for overdue claims? I’m swamped with manual drafting.
Manual drafting of letters for overdue claims is time‑consuming and overwhelming.

same incident came in both by phone and through the portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it.
Duplicate claims are created when the same incident is reported via phone and the portal because the system provides no alert.

Could you walk me through how to assign tasks to specific roles for claims handling?
The user doesn't know how to assign tasks to specific roles in claims handling.

we’ve been having some issues with how claims are assigned in our motor team — it’s not matching our workload or postcode zones.
Claims are being assigned in a way that doesn't align with the motor team's workload or postcode zones.

Garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it. The incorrect file type assignment is causing real delays and oversight risks.
Garage estimates are automatically placed in the wrong category/file type, requiring manual recategorisation and causing missed evidence and delays.

Every single day. We’ve got handlers spending hours on the phone instead of processing claims or managing reserves.
Handlers are spending hours on the phone each day instead of processing claims or managing reserves.

I’m trying to set up some saved filters on the claims list ... but I can’t seem to lock them in properly.
The user cannot lock saved filters on the claims list.

I’m trying to pull the latest reporting for our policyholders but I can’t access the portal. I think I’ve lost my password.
The user cannot access the portal because they have lost their password.

we’re getting pushback from our finance team because the report totals differ between the dashboard and the exported file. It’s causing some trust issues.
Report totals shown on the dashboard do not match the totals in the exported file, causing trust issues.

We’ve been managing claims and documents manually for years, and it’s becoming unsustainable.
The customer is handling claims and documents manually, which is no longer sustainable.

We’re still waiting on the multiple file upload feature — right now I have to add each document individually, which takes ages when handling large claims with suppliers and policyholders.
Customers must upload documents one by one because bulk upload is missing.

We had unannounced screen changes last time and it caused confusion and delays because staff had to relearn where everything was — we really need advance notice and previews going forward.
Unannounced screen changes cause staff confusion and delays because they have to relearn the interface.

We’ve had three handlers stuck for two days because their reserve changes are waiting for an approver who’s on leave — no delegate set up. Claims are stalled because reserve changes beyond handler authority are stuck in an approver’s queue with no backup — approval waiting list is blocking everything.
Handlers cannot complete reserve changes because there is no delegated approver, causing claim processing to stall.

garage estimates keep landing in correspondence — we have to manually recategorise them, and sometimes evidence gets missed because of it.
Garage estimates are automatically routed to the correspondence category, requiring manual recategorization and causing evidence to be missed.

we’ve had three people report the same customer login outage today, and it’s holding up claims processing.
Customers are experiencing a login outage that is delaying claims processing.

We’re still wrestling with how to track garage progress visibility without calling every supplier manually — it really breaks up our day and distracts from core claims work.
Customers cannot easily track garage progress visibility without manually calling each supplier.

we just need a bit of warning and maybe a preview before changes go live, so we don’t waste time retraining.
Customers need advance warning and a preview of interface changes before they go live to avoid wasted retraining time.

wanted to check if there’s a way to preview upcoming interface updates before they go live
Customers cannot preview upcoming interface updates before they are released.

Right now, we’re manually cross‑checking every new claim to avoid the same claim twice, which eats up time we could spend on supplier coordination or reporting.
Users have to manually cross‑check each new claim to prevent duplicate submissions, which is time‑consuming.

we need garage progress visibility baked into the system so we don’t have to interrupt our daily work with phone calls
The system lacks built‑in visibility of garage progress, forcing the team to interrupt work with phone calls.

we’re trying to pull a full report on outstanding claims and reserves but the system’s not showing updated supplier payments.
The system does not display updated supplier payments in the outstanding claims and reserves report.

we really need claim progress messages to go out via SMS and email to policyholders automatically.
The platform does not automatically send claim progress messages via SMS and email.

Yes, I reset it yesterday and still can’t view the reserves or generate supplier payments reports. It’s blocking our weekly reporting.
The user cannot view reserves or generate supplier payments reports after a reset, blocking their weekly reporting.

our handlers are spending half their day calling garages because we can’t see live repair progress in the system.
Handlers cannot see live repair progress, forcing them to call garages for updates.

It’s the unexpected interface changes — we keep having to retrain staff because buttons and menus shift without warning, and that’s costing us time and accuracy.
Unexpected interface changes force staff retraining and reduce time and accuracy.

can we talk about how reporting integrates with our existing policyholder records?
The customer needs guidance on integrating reporting with their existing policyholder records.

First, we need to set up a custom claim-reference format — our internal systems rely on specific prefixes and sequences. We really need to set up a custom claim-reference format because our internal systems use specific naming conventions and we can’t have mismatches when pulling reports or syncing with suppliers.
The platform does not allow configuring a custom claim-reference format required by the customer's internal naming conventions.

I need to schedule a recurring task for monthly reserves review — is that possible via the dashboard?
User cannot schedule a recurring monthly reserves review task through the dashboard.

Actually, I can’t log in right now — I think I need a password reset to proceed with the claims documents.
The user cannot log in because they need a password reset.

We need letters in Welsh for policyholders — it’s not just a nice-to-have, it’s tied to our renewal terms with Keelwater.
The platform does not provide letters in Welsh for policyholders, which is required for renewal terms.

We’re still seeing some delays with the webhook retries on our supplier payments module, and it’s causing issues with how we process claims and update policyholders in real time.
Webhook retries are delayed, causing real‑time claim processing and policyholder update issues.

I’m trying to set up some saved filters on the claims list to help my team track high‑priority cases, but I can’t seem to lock them in properly.
Saved filters on the claims list cannot be saved correctly.

we’ve got some ... handlers ... manually ... moving garage ... estimates out of ... correlation ... and it ... causing ... delays
Handlers are manually moving garage estimates out of correspondence, causing delays.

multiple file upload feature isn’t as smooth as we’d hoped — they’re having to upload documents one at a time still, which slows things down.
Claims handlers must upload documents one at a time because the multiple file upload feature is not working smoothly.

Can we see how reserves and payments sync with our existing accounting tools?
Customer wants to see how reserves and payments sync with their existing accounting tools.

Unexpected interface changes keep shifting where we click for reserves or payments — our staff are making errors because the controls aren’t where they were last week.
Unexpected interface changes move the controls for reserves and payments, causing staff to click the wrong places and make errors.

our team’s daily frustrations with the system’s lack of live updates from garages
The system does not provide live updates from garages, causing daily frustration for the team.

We need this fixed before the year-end claims surge.
The customer needs a critical issue fixed before the year‑end claims surge.

Reports: click "Export CSV", error exception
Exporting reports to CSV fails with an error.

We’ve had three people report the same customer login outage today, and it’s holding up claims processing — I’d appreciate any insight from your end.
Customers are unable to log in, which is delaying claims processing.

We’ve got a real issue where the same incident came in both by phone and web portal, and now we’ve got two separate claims with no alert to flag it — that’s what we’re calling a duplicate loss report, and it’s messing up our reserves and supplier coordination.
Duplicate loss reports create separate claims without any alert, causing confusion and split reserves.

we’re getting the same claim ... when ... portal … no alert ... at intake
Duplicate claims are created when a policyholder reports the same incident through multiple channels.

I’ve got a small request around document handling.
The customer wants an improvement to how documents are handled in the platform.

does your platform support API hooks for our legacy document system?
The platform does not currently offer API hooks for the customer's legacy document system.

I need to reset my password because I can’t access the claims dashboard this morning.
The customer cannot access the claims dashboard because they need to reset their password.

Finance is questioning which figure is correct because the export doesn’t match the dashboard.
The exported monthly claims reserves and payments report numbers do not match the figures shown on the dashboard.

we’re having trouble pulling updated reserves for our high-value claims this morning.
The user cannot pull updated reserves for high-value claims.

I’m trying to upload a claim document but the system says I’ve selected the wrong document category — can you help?
The system rejects the uploaded claim document because it thinks the selected document category is incorrect.

we’re missing visibility when tasks get stuck or letters go unacknowledged by policyholders
The user cannot see when tasks are stuck or when letters are not acknowledged by policyholders.

I need to reset my password for the claims portal — it’s not accepting my current one even though I’m certain it’s correct.
The claims portal is rejecting the customer's current password, preventing login.

We’ve got a few things to run through today, mainly around renewals and some reporting oddities.
The customer is encountering oddities in the reporting feature while working on renewals.

Yes, it’s specifically when a reserve change exceeds handler limits — the reserve authorisation delay blocks everything until the approver returns.
Reserve authorisation delay blocks all actions when a reserve change exceeds handler limits.

Administration: click "Overview", dead x1
The Overview button in the Administration section does not work when clicked.

we’ve got a few claims held up because the approver’s out and no one’s covering their queue.
Claims are stuck because the approver is unavailable and no one is covering their queue.

We’re seeing some issues with how claims get assigned and docs get filed
Claims are not being assigned correctly and documents are not being filed properly.

can we adjust the reserves on policyholder claims without triggering alerts?
Adjusting reserves on policyholder claims currently triggers alerts, which the user wants to avoid.

click "Document type", rage x5 ... click "Save"
The document type selection is unresponsive, forcing the user to click it repeatedly before they can save.

We’ve been trying to use the bulk upload function since the update, but it’s still not handling upload files together reliably — we get timeouts on batches over 50 documents.
The bulk upload feature times out on batches larger than 50 documents, making uploads unreliable.
